    """Total of ``amounts`` (integer cents) plus 17% tax.

    The returned value is an integer number of cents, rounded half up to
    the nearest cent.  ``amounts`` is only read, never modified.
    """
    net = sum(amounts)
    # Exact integer arithmetic: 17% of net, rounded half up.
    tax = (net * 17 + 50) // 100
    return net + tax

    whole, remainder = divmod(scaled, 100)
